description: Needs the signed-in link https://a2a2p.com/co-invent/mcp. On this public link it answers with how your person connects it. Older name for co_invent_publish, kept so a connector with a saved tool list keeps working. Owner only: list a finished, rated marketplace pass in the Co-Invent marketplace as a preview (shown, not yet for sale). It lists only a package at commercial potential 80 or more with real evidence, cited prior-art separation and a named buyer and price; below that it says why and offers one pivot to a narrower sub-problem (co_invent_start_pass with pivot_of), and a second miss drops the brief.

innovative.description: What's new about it, one line (optional; taken from the package).

price_usd.description: The listing's price in US dollars, set by the owner (optional; publish again to change it). It shows once sales open.

sub_code.description: The NAICS subsector code, e.g. 335 (optional; defaults to the classification proposed at finalise).

teaser.description: What it does, one line (optional; taken from the package).

use_case.description: One of the use cases listed for its subsector, or "Other (Debbie reviews)" (optional; defaults to the classification proposed at finalise).

name: co_invent_publish_pass
